resources.string: Switch to Wi-Fi Direct if the cable drops
If the car\'s USB port hangs mid-trip, Qonecta+ carries on over Wi-Fi Direct until the end of the trip. Your chosen connection doesn\'t change: the next trip uses the cable again.
The cable dropped: carrying on over Wi-Fi Direct

The car\'s USB port has hung. Qonecta+ carries on over Wi-Fi Direct until the end of the trip and uses the cable again on the next one. To go back to the cable now, choose “USB cable” in the widget or under “Change”.
The cable doesn\'t work with this car: Qonecta+ uses Wi-Fi Direct
To try the cable again, choose it under “Change”.
The cable isn\'t responding: back to your Wi-Fi connection
The car\'s USB port has hung. Qonecta+ carries on over the connection you chose until the end of the trip. To use the cable, choose “USB cable” in the widget or under “Change”.
The cable isn\'t responding and Wi-Fi is off
Turn on the phone\'s Wi-Fi and Qonecta+ will carry on over Wi-Fi Direct.
